title: Meetings and presentations
intro: Meetings run on fixed phrases. Learn to open, follow an agenda, guide people through slides, describe charts and trends accurately, and close with clear action points.
introBn: মিটিং চলে নির্দিষ্ট কিছু বাক্যে। শুরু করা, এজেন্ডা মানা, স্লাইড দেখানো, চার্ট বর্ণনা আর স্পষ্ট করণীয় দিয়ে শেষ করা শিখুন।

units.title: Opening, agenda and signposting
units.idea: Open a meeting by welcoming people and stating the purpose, go through the agenda, and use signposts so everyone knows where you are: Let's move on to, Going back to, As you can see.
units.ideaBn: মিটিং শুরুতে স্বাগত জানিয়ে উদ্দেশ্য বলুন, এজেন্ডা দেখান, আর Let's move on to, As you can see এর মতো সংকেত দিয়ে সবাইকে পথ দেখান।

formula.name: Open
formula.pos: Thanks for coming. · Let's get started. · The aim of today's meeting is to…

formula.name: Agenda
formula.pos: There are three items on the agenda. · First, … Then, … Finally, …

formula.name: Signpost
formula.pos: Let's move on to… · Going back to… · As you can see… · To sum up…

uses.rule: 'Let's' + base verb to start or move on.
uses.ex: Let's get started. / Let's move on to the budget.

uses.rule: 'The aim/purpose of this meeting is to' + base verb.
uses.ex: The purpose of this meeting is to agree the launch date.

uses.rule: Order items: first, then, after that, finally.
uses.ex: First, the sales figures. Then, the new hires. Finally, any other business.

uses.rule: 'As you can see' points to a slide.
uses.bn: স্লাইড দেখাতে As you can see।
uses.ex: As you can see on this slide, costs are lower.

uses.rule: Manage turns: Sorry to interrupt / Could I come in here? / Go ahead.
uses.ex: Sorry to interrupt, but could I add something?

traps.right: Let's move on to the next point.

traps.wrong: Today we will discuss about the budget.
As you see in the slide.
traps.right: As you can see on the slide.
traps.bn: As you can see on the slide।

drills.s: The aim of today's meeting ___ to plan the Eid campaign.
Let's move ___ to the next item on the agenda.

o: We need to discuss about the timeline.
We need to discuss on the timeline.
We need to discuss the timeline.
drills.a: We need to discuss the timeline.

drills.q: আপনারা দেখতে পাচ্ছেন, এই বছর খরচ কমেছে।
o: As you can see, costs have gone down this year.
As you are seeing, cost has down this year.
You can see, cost is decreased this year.
As you can see, costs have gone down in this year.
drills.a: As you can see, costs have gone down this year.
drills.x: As you can see + present perfect.

drills.s: Sorry to ___, but I have a quick question.
___ back to what Sara said, I think the deadline is too tight.
There are three items ___ the agenda today.

units.title: Describing charts, summarising and action points
units.idea: Describe trends with verb + adverb (rose sharply, fell slightly) or adjective + noun (a sharp rise, a slight drop). Use by for the change and to for the end point. Finish with a summary and clear action points: who does what by when.
units.ideaBn: প্রবণতা বোঝাতে rose sharply বা a sharp rise বলুন। পরিবর্তনের পরিমাণে by, শেষ মানে to। শেষে সারাংশ আর কে কী কবে করবে তা বলুন।

formula.name: Verb + adverb
formula.pos: Sales rose sharply. · Costs fell slightly. · Profit remained stable.

formula.name: Adj + noun
formula.pos: There was a sharp rise in sales. · a slight drop · a steady increase

formula.name: Wrap up
formula.pos: To sum up, … · So, the action points are… · Rafi will send the report by Friday.

uses.rule: Verbs: rise/rose, fall/fell, increase, decrease, remain stable, peak.
uses.ex: Exports fell in March and then peaked in June.

uses.rule: Adverb with verb, adjective with noun.
uses.bn: ক্রিয়ার সাথে adverb, বিশেষ্যর সাথে adjective।
uses.ex: Prices increased slightly. / There was a slight increase in prices.
Sales rose by 10% to 5 crore taka.
There was a sharp fall in orders.

uses.rule: Action points: name + will + verb + deadline.
uses.ex: Nadia will update the client by Thursday.

traps.bn: raise কিছুকে তোলা; rise নিজে ওঠা।

The number of users increased steady.

drills.a: The number of users increased steadily.

drills.q: বছরের বাকি সময় দাম স্থিতিশীল ছিল।

Prices were stabled rest of the year.
Prices remained stably for the rest of the year.

drills.a: Prices remained stable for the rest of the year.

drills.a: Rafi will send the revised report to the client by Thursday.
